snippet.title: Swapette Showdown Trailer
snippet.description:
Swapette Showdown is a competitive action puzzle game for one to four players! Swap the blocks to create matches! Battle as/against cute magical girls a.k.a. the Swapettes!
We are still in development, see links below for more info!
~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Follow @SwapetteGame on Twitter | Instagram | Facebook
Join out Discord  - discord.gg/swapetteshowdown
Support us on Patreon - patreon.com/swapetteshowdown
For more info visit SwapetteShowdown.com 
~~~~~~~~~~~~~
